name: Marine Philt
source:
Second part of the Nightmare Collection with [url=https://vndb.org/v4513]Dead of the Brain[/url] and [url=https://vndb.org/v6037]Dead of the Brain 2[/url].

In the first half of the 21st century, humanity started building space satellites, trying to sustain the working conditions in outer space by using a drug known as Marine Philt. Eventually the project was abandoned. One of the deserted satellites fell onto the Earth, causing a radioactive accident that forced the inhabitants of Neo Tokyo to dwell underground. One day, a young man named Seed heard a news report about a gruesome murder that occurred in a research facility. Together with his friends, Seed ventures into the building, only to discover another horrifying result of the satellite crash, which may put the entire city in immense danger.

[From [url=http://www.mobygames.com/game/pc98/nightmare-collection-ii-marine-philt]Moby Games[/url]]
translation:
《Nightmare Collection》的第二部，收录[url=https://vndb.org/v4513]《脑死》[/url]和[url=https://vndb.org/v6037]《脑死2》[/url]。

21世纪上半叶，人类开始建造太空卫星，并尝试利用一种名为“太空适应剂”的药物维持人在外太空作业所需的身体状态。后来，这项计划被废弃。其中一颗废弃卫星坠落地球，引发放射性事故，迫使新东京的居民转入地下生活。一天，名叫希德的年轻人从新闻中得知，一座研究设施里发生了一起骇人听闻的凶杀案。希德与朋友们一同闯入大楼，却在那里发现了卫星坠毁造成的另一项恐怖后果，整座城市都可能因此陷入巨大的危机。

[引自[url=http://www.mobygames.com/game/pc98/nightmare-collection-ii-marine-philt]Moby Games[/url]]
